div.head: Leis Wl 20
div.ab: De relief a cunte ki al rei afert: VIII chevals, enfrenez e enseelez [les IIII], e IIII haubercs e IIII haumes e IIII escuz e IIII lances e IIII espees. Les autres [IIII]: II chaceurs e II palefreis a freins e a chevestres.

The heriot of an earl, which falls to the King, is 8 horses—4 of them bridled and saddled—4 coats of mail, 4 helmets, 4 shields, 4 lances and 4 swords. Of the other 4 horses, 2 shall be hunters and 2 riding horses with bridles and halters.
